programme_name: AusTraits replication of lineage-context dependence in phylogenetic trait memory

relationship_to_discovery.rule: BIEN results motivate explicit replication predictions, but no AusTraits trait-memory rho may be opened until source-native support, semantics, phylogeny, system informativeness, crossed-core, and model-informativeness gates pass.

primary_question: After trait-specific mean memory-loss rates are controlled, does plant family identity explain a repeatable component of phylogenetic trait-memory loss in AusTraits?

primary_prediction.relationship_to_BIEN: Use the identical estimand, practical 10% reference, and interpretation categories used in the prequalified BIEN lineage-memory study.

trait_semantics.numeric: config type == numeric; source values are already standardised and range-checked by AusTraits; species state = median eligible value
trait_semantics.categorical: config type == categorical; species state = unique modal value; tied-mode species excluded

model_informativeness.trait_fixed_effects: deterministic centered means equally spaced from -0.10 to +0.10 and assigned by sorted trait name

real_analysis_if_all_gates_pass.response: Spearman(all unordered patristic distances, source-native trait-state dissimilarity); exact permutation-null mean zero

provenance_independence_gate.timing: after final outcome-blind core is fixed and before real AusTraits rho is opened
provenance_independence_gate.purpose: Quantify whether AusTraits contributing primary datasets overlap BIEN source citations used by the BIEN 201-system discovery core.

labels.low_overlap: may be described as independent-source replication
labels.material_overlap: describe only as independent-compilation / transport validation
labels.rule: Thresholds for these labels must be frozen before the overlap values are opened.

secondary_portability.statistic: same leave-one-family-out trait-mean versus global-mean portability_gain and within-family blocked permutation test used in BIEN
secondary_portability.role: secondary replication of cross-lineage trait portability; does not alter primary family-repeatability inference

hard_nonclaims: Do not call the source fully independent before provenance-overlap audit.
Do not compare family variance against trait variance.
Do not resurrect the closed time-space turnover programme.
Do not lower support, informativeness, degree, or model-informativeness thresholds.
Do not add a third database to rescue replication.
